pr_title: Fix cursor stucking in resize shape

issue_context.title: Cursor is sometimes stuck in resize shape
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

04cc06b

### System information

W10

### Issue description

![lH7rWFfJbA](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/145581179-2b70eb6d-9d4f-4391-8856-d7942ba52540.gif)
Happens randomly with any dialog. It's especially jarring when you close a dialog and your cursor changes for whatever reason.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open any non-maximized window/dialog
2. Move cursor to the border so it changes to "resize" shape
3. When you move cursor inside the dialog, it sometimes gets stuck in this shape

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments: It still sometimes happens in editor dialogs. I need to investigate it futher.
It happens all the time for me until I move my mouse over the title bar then it immediately resets. Windows 10 Godot 4  alpha 10 Iris Xe.

Seems to be happening in 3.x too.

idk what triggered it, but the cursor won't go back to arrow until I click outside the window:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/183115215-c17da7e1-890f-419e-a5eb-5085a824cd7a.mp4

When it goes into resize mode, it will stay like this.

Restarting fixed it, but it wasn't the first time it happened.
Is this still reproducible in 4.0 RC 3 or later?
Haven't seen this in a long time.

review_comments: Just to be sure, this removal (without replacing by `track_mouse_leave_event`) was intentional?
I think it's useless to call it twice since it is called at the WndProc/WM_ACTIVATE event now (which is a started event for the window)
